scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix sandbox && pip install -r server/requirements.txt && cd server && python -m scripts.reset
scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,sandbox,server -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix sandbox" "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir server --port 8000"
